notes.title: New Ganymede: Discovery Tour
notes.notes:
[b][h3]New Ganymede[/h3][/b] is an upcoming free-to-play open world indie sci-fi fantasy MMOARPG extravaganza where you can run, glide, shoot, slash, dash, roll and generally panic your way through co-op PVE with friends in a beautiful narrative driven world developed by an Australia-based team.

[h1][h2][b]New Ganymede: Discovery Tour![/b][/h2][/h1]
[h2][h3]Join us for an unforgettable streaming event as we unveil our highly anticipated game to the world! [/h3]
[/h2]
Get ready for an exciting event filled with surprises, exclusive gameplay, and an in-depth look at the masterminds behind the creation. 

[h3]What’s the lineup for New Ganymede Discovery Tour?[/h3]
[list]
[*] ➡️ Extended devlog + 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗮𝗹 
[*] ➡️ Meet the crew + 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
[/list][i]Tune-in for guaranteed never-seen-before content![/i]

[url=https://linktr.ee/newganymede]Follow us[/url] to join our development journey: learn about the process and production of indie games, behind the scenes and get excited about exclusive footage from our upcoming alpha demo.

Embark on an exclusive Discovery Tour - see you soon!
